comment.body:
Closing without merging following review.

**Rejection category:** `technical`
**Reviewed head:** `ee0f498df7b1b7e676d311831cee0b2d9aa50f8f`

**Reason:** The full horizontal TESCO Bank wordmark becomes too small in a 24/32 px square cell. Recognition at 54 px and an official source do not resolve the small-size usability defect documented in the October 6 audit.

**Required follow-up for the maintenance agent:** Find a supported compact original representation and verify it at 24 and 32 px on both light and dark backgrounds, or do not make this replacement. This rejection is about the chosen composition, not the Barclays transaction or a blanket ban on lettering.

This decision is based on `bank-icons-audit-2026-10-06.md`, `bank-icons-review-2026-10-05.pdf`, and `bank-icons-crosscheck-2026-10-05.pdf`, with the audit corrections taking precedence over unsupported cross-review claims.

[Supporting evidence](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/8b325265b31531546db848b824cf19f5120bc8d9/review-materials/16088/comparison-light.png?raw=true)

This rejection applies to this candidate, not permanently to the bank. A fresh proposal must resolve the specific defect above.
